diagrams.title: md-diagram-conversion architecture overview
diagrams.content:
@startuml
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

component "EditorHeader.tsx" as EditorHeader
component "ActionPill" as ActionPill
component "PromptPeekModal" as PromptPeekModal
component "SendPreviewModal" as SendPreviewModal
component "useEditorDiagramAction" as useEditorDiagramAction

component "MarkdownEditor.tsx" as MarkdownEditor
component "DiagramGalleryPanel" as DiagramGalleryPanel
component "DiagramCard" as DiagramCard
component "DiagramRender" as DiagramRender
component "DiagramLightbox" as DiagramLightbox
component "useDiagramSidecar" as useDiagramSidecar

component "uiStore.ts" as UiStore
component "editorCli.ts" as EditorCli
component "skillCompose.ts" as SkillCompose
component "terminalStore" as TerminalStore
component "window.pathly.fs" as FsBridge
component "mermaid" as Mermaid
artifact "<file>.diagrams.json" as Sidecar

EditorHeader --> ActionPill
ActionPill --> PromptPeekModal
ActionPill --> SendPreviewModal
SendPreviewModal --> useEditorDiagramAction
useEditorDiagramAction --> EditorCli
useEditorDiagramAction --> SkillCompose
useEditorDiagramAction --> TerminalStore
useEditorDiagramAction --> FsBridge
useEditorDiagramAction --> Sidecar

MarkdownEditor --> DiagramGalleryPanel
DiagramGalleryPanel --> DiagramCard
DiagramGalleryPanel --> DiagramLightbox
DiagramGalleryPanel --> useDiagramSidecar
useDiagramSidecar --> FsBridge
useDiagramSidecar --> Sidecar
DiagramCard --> DiagramRender
DiagramLightbox --> DiagramRender
DiagramRender --> Mermaid

EditorHeader --> UiStore
MarkdownEditor --> UiStore
DiagramGalleryPanel --> UiStore
@enduml

diagrams.title: md-diagram-conversion architecture mindmap
diagrams.content:
mindmap
  root((Architecture Proposal))
    Reality check vs SPEC §7
      SPEC paths vs real codebase
      SplitPill does not exist
      ActionPill is shared and props-driven
      MarkdownEditor path differs from spec
      EditorHeader hooks live under MarkdownEditor/EditorHeader/hooks
      Live run flow includes SendPreviewModal confirm step
      resolveActionPrompt defaults to composeClientSkill
    Layers touched
      EditorHeader layer
        EditorHeader.tsx
        diagramPresets.ts
        useEditorDiagramAction.ts
      MarkdownEditor panel
        MarkdownEditor.tsx
        DiagramGalleryPanel
        DiagramCard
        DiagramRender
        DiagramLightbox
        diagramSidecar.ts
        useDiagramSidecar.ts
      shared and services
        ActionPill
        PromptPeekModal
        SendPreviewModal
        cliEngine.ts
        skillCompose.ts
        window.pathly.fs
        studio package dependency mermaid
    Component tree
      MarkdownEditor.tsx
        AnalysisPanel
        DiagramGalleryPanel
        DiagramLightbox
        EditorHeader
          ActionPill Diagram
          Run path
          gear presets
          result chip
    State design
      Action slot
        split
        analyze
        diagram
      Sidecar path and panel flag
        mdEditorDiagramsPaths
        mdEditorDiagramPanelOpen
      Selectors
        selectMdEditorDiagram
        selectMdEditorDiagramsPath
      Persistence choice
        session-only state
        sidecar file is source of truth
    Sidecar I/O
      file.diagrams.json
      readSidecar
      appendDiagram
      removeDiagram
      writeSidecar
      append is agent-owned read-modify-write
      renderer reads and deletes only
      sync rules
        file open loads sidecar
        run completion polls sidecar
        delete removes card and closes panel if empty
        regenerate spawns a fresh run
      race condition mitigation
        one in-flight run per file
        cross-file runs use separate sidecars
    Spawn pipeline wiring
      reuse points
        buildCliArgv
        resolveActionPrompt pattern
        composeClientSkill
        getSpawnCwd
        terminalStore lifecycle
        window.pathly.terminal spawn exit kill
        pollForFile
        attachProgress
        setMdEditorAction
        stale-run self-heal effect
      differs from split
        outPath is diagrams json
        success stores sidecar path
        parse JSON and validate structure
        compose kind diagram and skill development/diagram
      header wiring
        loadEditorCli diagram
        loadPreset diagram
        pendingRun kind diagram
        third ActionPill
    Mermaid rendering
      lazy import
        dynamic import mermaid
        cached instance
        unique render id
      safety
        securityLevel strict
        loading and render-error states
        unmount guard
      theming
        read tokens css values via getComputedStyle
        rerender on theme switch
    Dependency direction
      downward and sideways only
      no store imports a component
      no component reaches into main
    Risks
      bundle size
      theming fragility
      sidecar race
      untrusted source
      malformed JSON
      render id collision
    Key decisions and trade-offs
      reuse ActionPill
      copy panel CSS block
      lightbox uses DiagramRender full mode
      agent owns append, renderer reads and deletes
      zoom pan uses CSS transform
      plantuml is source-only for now
    Implementation sequence
      state scaffold
      CLI and presets
      sidecar I/O
      spawn hook
      header pill
      gallery panel and card
      render dispatch
      mermaid integration
      lightbox
      polish and verification
    Verification
      typecheck
      manual workflow
    Open questions
      none
